title: dialog.showMessageBox promise resolution is delayed when shown before any BrowserWindow on Linux
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

41.2.0, 40.8.5, and 39.8.7

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Ubuntu

### Operating System Version

Ubuntu 24.04

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

I expect that, after a user interacts with a dialog box displayed with `dialog.showMessageBox` before any other windows are displayed, the `showMessageBox` promise is resolved immediately.

### Actual Behavior

The `showMessageBox` promise resolution is delayed by several seconds, as demonstrated in the attached video.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/834362d2-6736-431f-8dcb-d11568691f7b

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/Harrison-M/4c6fe09e54d3ec83ef6b79324785314e

### Additional Information

This only happens when the application is launched from the user's primary monitor. When launched from a secondary monitor, the message box behaves as expected and returns the promise immediately after the user clicks "OK."

In the gist, I have included a second call to `showMessageBox` after the window is displayed to demonstrate that message boxes behave as expected when a `BrowserWindow` is present.
